name: EM Carry-to-Vol Rank vs Next-Month FX Return (BRL, MXN, ZAR)
description: Monthly carry-to-vol ranking of BRL, MXN, ZAR vs USD (2010–2025). Carry = (EM 1M rate − US Fed Funds) / 100 / 12. Vol = 30-day realized vol (annualized) / sqrt(12), floored at 0.001. Score = carry / vol_floor. At each month-end, cs_rank descending (rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol). Next-month EM FX return = −(next month-end USDFX / current month-end USDFX − 1). Stats table and bar chart show avg return, hit rate, and count by rank (1/2/3).
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM CARRY-TO-VOL RANK vs NEXT-MONTH FX RETURN
# =============================================================================
# Universe: USDBRL, USDMXN, USDZAR (all primary assets for cs_rank context)
# Carry = (EM 1M rate - US Fed Funds) / 100 / 12  [decimal monthly carry]
# Vol   = 30-day realized vol (annualized) / sqrt(12), floored at 0.001
# Score = carry / vol_floor
# Rank  = cs_rank descending at each month-end (rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol)
# FX return convention: USDFX pairs → falling = EM strengthening
#   next-month EM return = -(next_eom_close / curr_eom_close - 1)
# =============================================================================

# --- Price data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# --- FRED: EM short-term interest rates (monthly, % per annum) ---
# Brazil: Call Money/Interbank Rate (IRSTCI01BRM156N, monthly through 2026-01)
br_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="IRSTCI01BRM156N", use_alfred=False)()
br_rate = ffill(br_rate_raw.result)

# Mexico: Call Money/Interbank Rate (IRSTCI01MXM156N, monthly through 2026-01)
mx_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="IRSTCI01MXM156N", use_alfred=False)()
mx_rate = ffill(mx_rate_raw.result)

# South Africa: 3-Month Interbank Rate (IR3TIB01ZAM156N, monthly through 2026-01)
za_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="IR3TIB01ZAM156N", use_alfred=False)()
za_rate = ffill(za_rate_raw.result)

# US: Federal Funds Effective Rate (FEDFUNDS, monthly)
us_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="FEDFUNDS", use_alfred=False)()
us_rate = ffill(us_rate_raw.result)

# --- Select EM rate per asset using is_asset_ref ---
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDBRL")()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDMXN")()
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDZAR")()

em_rate_pct = conditional_select(is_brl, br_rate, is_mxn, mx_rate, is_zar, za_rate, 0.0)

# --- Carry: (EM rate - US rate) / 100 / 12 → decimal monthly carry ---
carry_monthly = (em_rate_pct - us_rate) / 100.0 / 12.0

# --- Realized vol: 30-day annualized, convert to monthly ---
# volatility() outputs annualized decimal (e.g., 0.20 = 20% ann vol)
ann_vol = volatility(period=30)(close)
vol_monthly = ann_vol / sqrt(12.0)

# Floor vol at 0.001 to avoid division by zero
vol_floor = where(vol_monthly > 0.001, vol_monthly, 0.001)

# --- Carry-to-vol score ---
carry_to_vol = carry_monthly / vol_floor

# --- Month-end detection ---
is_eom = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.end)(bar_idx)

# --- Snapshot carry-to-vol at month-end, ffill to all bars ---
# cs_rank needs a value on every bar; we snapshot at EOM and carry forward
ctv_eom = where(is_eom, carry_to_vol)
ctv_filled = ffill(ctv_eom)

# --- Cross-sectional rank at each bar (descending: rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol) ---
# cs_rank runs across all 3 assets simultaneously at each timestamp
rank = cs_rank(ascending=False)(ctv_filled)

# --- Month-end close snapshot ---
close_eom = where(is_eom, close)
close_eom_filled = ffill(close_eom)

# --- Next-month EM FX return ---
# forward_returns(period=1) on the month-end-only series gives next EOM close / curr EOM close - 1
# But forward_returns works on every bar; we need to compute it on the EOM-snapshotted close
# Strategy: use forward_returns on close, then snapshot at EOM
# fwd_ret_raw = (close_at_next_eom / close_at_curr_eom) - 1 (simple return, USDFX convention)
# EM appreciation = -(USDFX return), so negate
fwd_ret_usdfx = forward_returns(period=1)(close_eom_filled)
fwd_ret_em = -1.0 * fwd_ret_usdfx

# --- Pair rank (from current EOM) with next-month return ---
# rank_eom: the rank assigned at current month-end
rank_eom = where(is_eom, rank)
rank_eom_filled = ffill(rank_eom)

# The forward return at bar T is the return from T to T+1 month-end
# rank_eom_filled at bar T is the rank at the most recent month-end
# We want: for each month-end bar, what was the rank, and what was the next-month return?
# fwd_ret_em at month-end bar T = return from T to next month-end → correct pairing

# Filter returns by rank bucket (only on month-end bars where rank is valid)
is_rank1 = is_eom and is_valid(rank_eom) and (rank_eom == 1.0)
is_rank2 = is_eom and is_valid(rank_eom) and (rank_eom == 2.0)
is_rank3 = is_eom and is_valid(rank_eom) and (rank_eom == 3.0)

ret_rank1 = where(is_rank1, fwd_ret_em)
ret_rank2 = where(is_rank2, fwd_ret_em)
ret_rank3 = where(is_rank3, fwd_ret_em)

# Hit rate: 1.0 if return > 0, else 0.0 (mean = fraction of positive months)
hit_rank1 = where(is_rank1, 1.0 if fwd_ret_em > 0.0 else 0.0)
hit_rank2 = where(is_rank2, 1.0 if fwd_ret_em > 0.0 else 0.0)
hit_rank3 = where(is_rank3, 1.0 if fwd_ret_em > 0.0 else 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTER 1: Cross-Sectional Summary Table
# Rows = assets (BRL, MXN, ZAR)
# Columns = avg return / hit rate / count for rank 1, 2, 3
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title="Carry-to-Vol Rank vs Next-Month FX Return (2010–2025)",
    category="Carry-to-Vol Analysis",
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="Carry-to-Vol Rank vs Next-Month FX Return",
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Rank 1 — Avg Return",  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Rank 1 — Hit Rate",    type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Rank 1 — Count",       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count),
            ColumnSpec(title="Rank 2 — Avg Return",  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Rank 2 — Hit Rate",    type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Rank 2 — Count",       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count),
            ColumnSpec(title="Rank 3 — Avg Return",  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Rank 3 — Hit Rate",    type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Rank 3 — Count",       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count)
        ]
    ),
    order=0
)(ret_rank1, hit_rank1, ret_rank1, ret_rank2, hit_rank2, ret_rank2, ret_rank3, hit_rank3, ret_rank3)



# =============================================================================
# REPORTER 2: Bar chart — avg next-month return by carry-to-vol rank
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title="Avg Next-Month EM FX Return by Carry-to-Vol Rank",
    category="Carry-to-Vol Analysis",
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label="Avg Next-Month Return",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    series_names=["Rank 1 (Top)", "Rank 2 (Mid)", "Rank 3 (Bottom)"],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=1
)(ret_rank1, ret_rank2, ret_rank3)
